title: EndScreenDef
description:
An end screen definition from JSON type `"end_screen"`.

Defines a screen displayed when the player dies, with ASCII art and stats.

added_info.description: Additional info sections (lines of text with positions).

condition.description: Condition under which this end screen is shown.

picture_id.description: ID of the ASCII art picture to display.

priority.description: Priority for selecting which end screen to show.
